title: Could you keep your voice down, please?
pt: Foco da aula: pedir educadamente que o outro mude o comportamento

solo90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Excuse me, could you keep your voice down, please? I am trying to study for an exam tomorrow.
lines.pt: Com licença, você poderia falar mais baixo, por favor? Estou tentando estudar para uma prova amanhã.

lines.en: Oh, I am so sorry. I did not realize I was talking so loudly. I will go outside to finish this call.
lines.pt: Ah, sinto muito. Não percebi que estava falando tão alto. Vou lá fora terminar esta ligação.

lines.en: Thank you, that is very kind. Would you mind turning your phone off, too? It has been buzzing for ten minutes.
lines.pt: Obrigada, é muito gentil. Você se importaria de desligar o celular também? Ele está vibrando há dez minutos.

lines.en: Of course. I should have done it when I came in. Is it okay if I sit at the next table after my call?
lines.pt: Claro. Eu devia ter feito isso quando entrei. Posso sentar na mesa ao lado depois da ligação?

lines.en: Sure, but would you mind not moving the chairs? The noise on this floor tends to carry.
lines.pt: Claro, mas você se importaria de não mexer nas cadeiras? O barulho neste andar tende a se espalhar.

lines.en: No problem, I will be careful. By the way, are you studying law? I noticed your thick book.
lines.pt: Sem problema, terei cuidado. A propósito, você estuda direito? Notei seu livro grosso.

lines.en: Medicine, actually. Anatomy. I would appreciate it if you could tell your friends to be quiet when they arrive.
lines.pt: Medicina, na verdade. Anatomia. Eu agradeceria se você pudesse pedir aos seus amigos que fiquem quietos quando chegarem.

lines.en: I will tell them. One of them is always loud, so I might suggest moving to the cafeteria downstairs.
lines.pt: Vou avisar. Um deles é sempre barulhento, então posso sugerir irmos para a lanchonete lá embaixo.

lines.en: Good idea. The librarian warned two people yesterday, so everyone is a little nervous today.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. A bibliotecária advertiu duas pessoas ontem, então todo mundo está um pouco nervoso hoje.

lines.en: Understood. Could I borrow your highlighter for a minute? I left mine at home, and I want to mark a page.
lines.pt: Entendido. Posso pegar seu marca-texto emprestado por um minuto? Deixei o meu em casa e quero marcar uma página.

lines.en: Sure, here you are. Just do not press hard, please, because it is almost empty, and it is my last one.
lines.pt: Claro, aqui está. Só não aperte forte, por favor, porque está quase vazio, e é o meu último.

teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

group: Leia o objetivo em voz alta: “Peça com educação que o outro mude o comportamento: Could you keep your voice down? Would you mind not…? I wo…”.

facts.big: could you · would you mind + -ing · I would appreciate it if you could
facts.label: Pedir que o outro mude
facts.sub: Diga Could you keep your voice down, please?

facts.label: Pedido educado
facts.sub: Use could you para pedir algo de forma educada: Could you keep your voice down, please? O verbo fica na base, sem to. Adicione please para soar mais gentil.

facts.label: Pedir que alguém pare
facts.sub: Would you mind + -ing pede que o outro faça ou deixe de fazer algo: Would you mind turning your phone off? Would you mind not moving the chairs?

compare.ask: Could you keep your voice down, please?
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “fale mais baixo, por favor” e já parece educado, dependendo do tom.
compare.tip: Diga: “Could you keep your voice down, please?”
compare.us: Em inglês, use could you, would you mind + -ing ou I would appreciate it if you could para suavizar: Could you keep your voice down, please? O tom e o please ajudam muito.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Could you keep your voice down? is a polite request.
items.why: Could makes it softer than a command.

items.s: Would you mind + -ing asks someone not to do something.
items.why: Would you mind not moving the chairs?

items.s: A highlighter is a pen to mark words.
items.why: It makes them stand out in color.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Could you keep your voice down? is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (Could makes it softer than a command.)
Would you mind + -ing asks someone not to do something. → Verdadeiro (Would you mind not moving the chairs?)
A highlighter is a pen to mark words. → Verdadeiro (It makes them stand out in color.)

pages.title: Could you keep your voice down, please · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a Boston library. Nell is studying for an anatomy exam. The room is almost silent. Leo comes in and answers his phone. His voice is much too loud. Nell decides to ask politely.

“Excuse me, could you keep your voice down, please? I am trying to study for an exam tomorrow.” says Nell. “Oh, I am so sorry. I did not realize I was talking so loudly. I will go outside to finish this call.” says Leo. “Thank you, that is very kind. Would you mind turning your phone off, too? It has been buzzing for ten minutes.” says Nell.
